note.text: Additional required outcome: run the Codex app server inside the MicroVM and enable Codex remote control so a Codex CLI or ChatGPT desktop client outside the VM can attach to the running in-VM Codex session. Treat the connection as a deliberate network trust boundary: research the current supported Codex interfaces, bind only what is necessary, expose only an explicit endpoint, require the strongest supported authentication and authorization, avoid leaking reusable guest or host credentials, and document discovery, connection, lifecycle, and disconnect behavior. Remote clients must control the guest Codex process without gaining direct host filesystem, process, device, or socket access. Reconcile this inbound control channel with the requirement to minimize guest access to host services, and document residual risks such as port forwarding, client trust, and any protocol limitations.
